rule: relations_query.lean (its header is the rule) run with the library's root module imported, one environment per library; a line is a shape test on a theorem's type after telescoping its binders (hyps = Prop-typed binders, rel e = (R, a, b) for e = R .. a b): S = concl R a b with exactly one hyp R' a b (or R' b a: flip), or R' a b ↔ R a b; C = concl R (c s..) (c t..) with every position shared or related by a hyp, all hyps used; O = one side a constructor application containing the other side or its hyp partner; F = R a a without hyps; L = R u b / R a u with u a data-free constant application; B = ∀/∃ ↔ ∀/∃; I = registered instances of the classes the library's own declarations take as instance-implicit binders. Deprecated and internal names skipped.
query: python3 harness/tools/tables/gen_relations.py --envs envs/strata-v4.26.0=Strata,envs/cslib-v4.32.0=Cslib,envs/arklib-v4.31.0=ArkLib,envs/physlib-v4.32.0=Physlib: lean relations_query.lean per environment

exclude.rule: records whose thm / name is a declaration name listed in $LRA_TABLE_EXCLUDE (default data/benchmark_warmup.jsonl) are dropped at generation time: a benchmark row's own theorem never enters a table (plan §1.1 K0)
